accueil.title: Limit Breaker: the workout tracker where every level is earned
accueil.description: Workout tracker for Android: log your sets, track your records, and level up only when you actually train. No account required, no trackers, paid once.
accueil.h1: Your progress is earned under the bar
accueil.chapeau: Limit Breaker logs your sets in a few taps, tracks your records, and raises your level — only when you actually train.
accueil.bientot: Coming soon to Google Play · Android

seance.h2: Your session, logged in a few taps
seance.p: Start a workout: each exercise opens with your last session already filled in. Adjust a weight or the reps, then save. The plate calculator tells you what to load on each side of the bar. Each exercise can carry your own image: a photo taken with your phone, or any image you choose.
seance.alt_seance: Session in progress: bench press, with the last session already filled in (195 × 3, 185 × 9, 175 × 7)
seance.alt_disques: Plate calculator: 195 lbs, that is 45 + 25 + 5 on each side, including a 45 lb bar

niveau.p: The home screen shows your level and how many sessions stand between you and the next one. A session is a day you actually trained: opening the app doesn't count.
niveau.alt: Limit Breaker home screen at level 18, with its golden aura

auras.p: Every level is earned under the bar, one session after another — and your aura changes on the way.

records.p: Every set you log feeds the exercise's records and its curve over time: heaviest weight, most reps, and the goal you set yourself.
records.alt: Exercise statistics: weight and rep records, curve of the heaviest weight

corps.h2: A 3D body that reads your training
corps.p: It shows where your weekly volume stands against ten sets per muscle group, which muscles are lagging, where you are progressing, and the pains you report. And when you don't know what to train, it proposes today's session.
corps.alt_volume: 3D body, balance view: weekly sets per muscle group against a target of ten
corps.alt_progression: 3D body, progress view: improvement by region over 30 days
corps.alt_seance: What to do today: a proposed session of exercises for the muscles that are ready

historique.p: The calendar marks your training days, and every session keeps its sets, weights and reps.
historique.alt: History: October 2026 calendar and the sets of one session

promesses.p: No account required: the app runs on your phone, even offline. If you turn on sync, the copy goes to your own Google Drive, and nowhere else.
No advertising and no analytics, in the app or on this site.
A single purchase. No subscription, nothing to unlock later.
The app follows your phone's language, or the one you pick for it.

support.title: Support · Limit Breaker
support.description: Limit Breaker help: Google Drive sync, changing phones, refunds, languages, deleting your data, contact.
support.corps_html:
A question, a bug, an idea: write to contact@limitbreakerfit.com. We answer in English or French.

How do I back up my sessions to Google Drive?

In the ☰ menu, open Settings and connect your Google account. The app then asks for access to your Drive: it only sees the files it creates itself, in a folder named LimitBreakerFitApp. Let automatic upload do its job, or tap Sync now.

Sync is optional: without it, everything stays on your phone.

I'm changing phones: how do I get my data back?

Install Limit Breaker on the new phone with the same Google Play account, connect the same Google account in Settings, and sync: your sessions come back from your Drive.

If sync was never turned on on the old phone, your data never left it: sync from the old phone first.

Does the app work offline?

Yes. Everything is logged and viewed offline; only syncing with Drive needs a connection.

How do I get a refund?

Purchases go through Google Play, which handles refunds. You can return the app yourself from Google Play within two hours of buying it. After that, Google reviews requests made within 48 hours. Past that, write to us at contact@limitbreakerfit.com.

How do I change the app's language?

The app follows your phone's language. You can also give it a different one without touching the rest of the phone: Settings → Apps → Limit Breaker → Language. Nine languages are available: English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean and Chinese.

How do I delete all my data?

On your phone: uninstalling the app deletes everything it keeps there.

On your Drive: the copy belongs to you; delete the LimitBreakerFitApp folder. To remove the app's access to your Google account: myaccount.google.com/permissions.

In your Android backup: if your phone's backup is on, Android may copy the app's data into it (never your progress photos). You manage it in your phone's backup settings.

We have nothing to delete on our side: your data never reaches us. The details are in the privacy policy.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy · Limit Breaker
privacy.description: Privacy policy of the Limit Breaker Android app and limitbreakerfit.com: your data stays on your phone and in your own Google Drive.
privacy.corps_html:
In short. Your data stays on your phone. If you turn on sync, a copy goes to your own Google Drive. We receive none of your data: no server of ours, no account with us, no advertising, no analytics, no trackers. You can delete everything yourself, at any time.

Person in charge and contact

This policy covers the Limit Breaker Android app, distributed on Google Play, and this website, limitbreakerfit.com.

Person in charge of protecting personal information: the developer of Limit Breaker, at contact@limitbreakerfit.com.

What the app stores on your phone

  • Your exercises, workouts and sessions: sets, weights, reps and other measurements, dates, notes, tags and favorites.
  • The pains you report: the affected area (a muscle or a joint), the date you report it and the date you clear it. This is health data: it stays under your control, just like everything else.
  • Your progress photos, if you take any, and the images you add to your exercises.
  • Your settings.
  • If you sign in with Google: your account's name, email address and profile photo address, to show who is signed in.

Everything is stored in the app's private space on your phone. We have no access to it.

The app uses the camera only when you take a progress photo. It needs no other sensitive permission.

Syncing with your Google Drive (optional)

If you connect your Google account and allow Drive, the app copies to your Drive, in a folder named LimitBreakerFitApp: your training data (including reported pains), your exercise images, your progress photos, and archives of their previous versions.

  • The permission requested is drive.file: the app sees and changes only the files it created itself. It has no access to the rest of your Drive.
  • Data travels directly between your phone and Google, encrypted in transit (HTTPS). It never goes through us.
  • This copy is kept by Google under its own terms and privacy policy.

Your Google account data

  • Access: through Sign in with Google, your name, email address and profile photo address; through the drive.file Drive permission, only the files the app created.
  • Use: showing the signed-in account, and saving then reading back the copy of your data in your Drive. Nothing else: no advertising, no profiling, no sale, no training of artificial intelligence models.
  • Storage: your name, email and photo address on your phone; your files in your Drive. The app stores no password.
  • Sharing: none. This data never reaches us, and the app passes it to no one.

What we don't do

  • No server of ours, no account to create with us.
  • No advertising.
  • No analytics, audience measurement or tracking tools, in the app or on this site.
  • No selling, renting or sharing of data.

Third-party services involved

  • Google Play handles purchase, refunds, installation and updates, under Google's privacy policy.

If you email us

If you email us, we use your address and message only to answer you, and keep them for as long as it takes to handle your request.

This website

limitbreakerfit.com uses no cookies, no analytics and no third-party content.

Retention and deletion

  • On your phone: your data stays until you delete it in the app or uninstall the app, which erases everything.
  • In your Drive: as long as you keep it there. Delete the LimitBreakerFitApp folder to erase it, and remove the app's access at myaccount.google.com/permissions.

We hold no other data about you.

Security

Android isolates the app's data in its private space. Exchanges with Google are encrypted. Access to your Drive goes through a Google permission you can withdraw at any time, and the app only sees its own files.

Your rights

You can ask us for access to your information, its correction or its deletion at contact@limitbreakerfit.com, or contact a data protection authority (the CNIL in France, the Commission d'accès à l'information in Quebec).

Changes

If this policy changes, the date at the top of the page changes with it. A significant change will also be announced in the app's release notes.
